comments.text: one of my favourite vector games on my Atari 800XL was Mercenary. It was this open world type game, felt amazing at the time. [LINK] it wasn't that graphics was the best (compared to something like rescuse on fractalus [VIDEO] ), it was just a big vector world with quite a lot of places to explore.

comments.author: danieldk
comments.story: Ace of spades, Minecraft like FPS
comments.why: Rescue on Fractalus uses fractals to draw mountains.
comments.text: I fondly remember NovaLogic's Comanche series. While it isn't of the 'world building' genre, its voxel engine was very impressive for its time: [LINK] Also interesting (historically) is 'Rescue on Fractalus'. Not just for its cheesy name, but also due to its reliance on fractals to draw 3D mountain sceneries: [LINK] ! Edit: videos of both games: [LINK] [VIDEO]
